test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following Fundamental Rights are **not** available to foreigners in India?
1. Right against discrimination (Article 15)
2. Freedom of speech and expression (Article 19(1)(a))
3. Right to protection in respect of conviction (Article 20)
4. Right to life and personal liberty (Article 21)
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 and 2 only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Constitution of India** grants certain **Fundamental Rights** exclusively to **Indian citizens**, while others are available to both citizens and **foreigners** (except enemy aliens).
 
• **Article 15** provides for the prohibition of discrimination on grounds only of **religion**, **race**, **caste**, **sex**, or **place of birth**. This right is guaranteed only to the **citizens** of India and is not available to **foreigners**. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• **Article 19(1)(a)** guarantees the freedom of **speech and expression**. Along with other freedoms under **Article 19** (assembly, association, movement, residence, and profession), this is strictly reserved for **Indian citizens** to protect the **sovereignty** and **integrity** of the nation. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
